name: 画像で選ぶ語句
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup correction
Edit Image1 only to fix typography and protect original illustration style. ORIGINAL source Image2 controls all icon/artwork geometry, flat colors, proportions, optical weight, details and spacing; generated mock is secondary. Images3,4,5 are exact original milk,coffee,tea crops. Original croissant is visible clearly in Image2. These originals have flat solid-color artwork, NOT softly shaded or gradient artwork.
Change four labels “牛乳”,“コーヒー”,“お茶”,“クロワッサン” to Meiryo REGULAR14/24,zero tracking, ordinary thin body text, no bold. Keep exact labels/order/placement.
Replace the newly shaded illustrations with the original flat artwork, matching every silhouette, cow mark, carton/glass overlap, coffee handle/liquid marks, tea bag/yellow saucer and croissant segment. No repainting, gloss, light modeling, texture or gradients inside artwork. Preserve original sizes and crop.
Keep the rest fixed: four white rounded cards in2x2, top-right selected pale blue with blue border and label, white canvas, quiet neutral outlines and original subtle bottom lip. Blend coffee image background into selected blue, no square edge. No extra text, control, green CTA, checkmark, heading or logo. Return exactly one corrected component.
reviewNotes: Correction inspected: proper labels, blue selected coffee card, white surfaces and card count maintained. Original flat artwork still receives shading/texture and labels remain heavier than Regular14/24. Protected-art and typography fidelity unresolved after bounded correction. All attempts retained, no owner/native/runtime acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Mobbin connector の image_url から原画像バイトを保存
